mentions.name: AuthProxy
mentions.description: AuthProxy is an open source embedded integration-platform-as-a-service with an embedded connector marketplace for connecting to third-party systems and a proxy that handles credentials automatically. It has been in development for a couple of years and is currently being used to build an MCP gateway for internal tooling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on AuthProxy, an open source embedded integration-platform-as-a-service. It has an embedded connector marketplace that lets you connect to 3rd party systems, then provides a proxy that handles the credentials automatically.
mentions.author: rmorlok
